title: fabric-manifest/1 (proposed DEC-0190): an agent's or project's declaration of the twelve manifest articles
description: fabric.manifest.json at the root of an agent's or project's repository: for each article M-1 to M-12 of the manifest, met with its evidence, owed with its backlog row and date, or not applicable with a reason; and the bindings a machine checks: the two MCP doors, the placement and local operator, the health surface, the secret slots by name, the forks, the decision register. Closed at every level. Semantic rule FAC-SEM-187. docs/specification/manifest.md.

kind.description: agent: a program that acts for someone (serves a surface, runs work, holds a model budget); project: anything else kept in a repository (an app, a site, a library, a contract, a knowledge base). It decides which articles may be not-applicable (MF-2).

organization.description: The scope label org/project every entity of this repository carries (M-4).

contract.description: The fabric-agent-contract tag (v<version>+<YYYY-MM-DD>[.<n>]) or commit the articles were rendered from.

rendered.description: The path of the rendered MANIFEST.md.

placement.description: Where the agent runs (M-1, MF-5): local, cloud or both; an agent names at least one, a project that runs nothing gives an empty list (FAC-SEM-187).

local.description: The coding agent that may drive a local placement: a runner kind of the runners register (claude-code, hermes, ...) or any.

operator.description: Who operates a local placement (M-1, MF-5); absent when no coding agent drives it.

doors.description: The two doors of one domain, one ending in search and one in execute (MF-4, FAC-SEM-187).

direct.description: At most three tools served beside the doors, each with its reason: the measured case of DEC-0180 or a name the contract defines.

mcp.description: The MCP surface (M-1): null when the repository serves no MCP server.

inventory.description: The inventory pairing every function a person reaches with the operation behind it (docs/agent-surface.md, agent-surface/1); null when nothing is reached by a person.

tool.description: The MCP tool or operation answering agent-health/1.

cli.description: The command answering agent-health/1, such as 'example health --json'.

health.description: Where agent-health/1 is answered (M-3, MF-5): an empty object when nothing is.

secrets.description: The secret slots this repository needs, by name only (M-5, MF-6): <project>/<env>/<NAME> or <NAME>.

path.description: Where the foreign code lives in the repository, or . for a repository that is itself a fork.

upstream.description: The upstream repository, an https URL without credentials or query.

commit.description: The exact upstream commit the fork or copy is pinned to.

changes.description: The file recording our changes to the upstream code.

forks.description: Foreign code used through a fork or a pinned copy (M-6, MF-7).

path.description: A path relative to the repository root (MF-3): forward slashes, no leading / or ~, no . or .. segment, no backslash, colon or control character; a trailing / names a folder.

tool.description: An MCP tool or operation name (1 to 128 of ASCII letters, digits, '_', '-' and '.').

evidence.description: Paths that show the article is met; at least one when met (FAC-SEM-187).

row.description: The backlog row that meets the article, such as CT-353.

by.description: The date by which the article is met.

owed.description: Present exactly when status is owed (FAC-SEM-187).

reason.description: Why the article does not apply; present exactly when status is not-applicable (FAC-SEM-187).
